```{r}

library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r}
# Render Level 1: Best hit ID per query sequence
reactable(
  summary_bold_df,
  theme = dynamic_theme,
  highlight = TRUE,
  compact = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 100, 
  onClick = "expand",
  style = list(fontSize = "13px"), 
  columns = list(
    query_id = colDef(name = "Query Name", minWidth = 150),
    top_id = colDef(
      name = "Identification Result", 
      minWidth = 200,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (value == "No Hit") {
          htmltools::span(style = "color: #e06c75; font-style: italic;", value)
        } else {
          htmltools::span(style = "font-weight: 600;", value)
        }
      }
    ),
    hit_id = colDef(
        name = "Top Hit Database ID", 
        minWidth = 250,
        html = TRUE,
        cell = generate_bold_link
    ),
    pident = colDef(
      name = "Identity", 
      format = colFormat(digits = 2, suffix = "%"),
      cell = function(value) if(is.na(value)) "-" else sprintf("%.2f%%", value)
    ),
    qcovhsp = colDef(
      name = "Coverage", 
      format = colFormat(digits = 0, suffix = "%"),
      cell = function(value) if(is.na(value)) "-" else sprintf("%.0f%%", value)
    ),
    evalue = colDef(
      name = "E-value", 
      cell = function(value) if(is.na(value)) "-" else sprintf("%.2e", value)
    ),
    bitscore = colDef(
      name = "Bit Score", 
      cell = function(value) if(is.na(value)) "-" else sprintf("%.1f", value)
    )
  ),
  details = function(index) {
    current_query <- summary_bold_df$query_id[index]
    
    # Filter for all hits corresponding to this query
    sub_df <- bold_hits %>% 
      filter(query_id == current_query, !is.na(hit_id)) %>%
      select(hit_id, top_id, taxonomy, pident, qcovhsp, evalue, bitscore, overlap, mismatch, gaps)
    
    # If no hits, provide a clean fallback message instead of a broken table
    if (nrow(sub_df) == 0) {
      return(
        htmltools::div(
          style = "padding: 20px; background-color: transparent; font-style: italic; color: var(--tbl-text); opacity: 0.8;",
          "No matching BOLD records found for this query sequence."
        )
      )
    }
    
    # Render Level 2: Nested Table of all hits for the query
    htmltools::div(
      style = "padding: 16px; background-color: transparent; border-left: 4px solid var(--tbl-accent);",
      htmltools::h5(paste("All BOLD Hits for:", current_query), style="margin-top:0; margin-bottom: 15px; color: var(--tbl-text);"),
      
      reactable(
        sub_df,
        theme = dynamic_theme,
        highlight = TRUE,
        compact = TRUE,
        onClick = "expand",
        style = list(fontSize = "12px"), 
        columns = list(
          hit_id = colDef(
            name = "Top Hit Database ID", 
            minWidth = 250,
            html = TRUE,
            cell = generate_bold_link
          ),
          top_id = colDef(name = "Organism", minWidth = 140, style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
          taxonomy = colDef(name = "Taxonomic Lineage", minWidth = 350, style = list(color = "#7f848e", fontSize = "11px")),
          pident = colDef(name = "Identity", width = 85, format = colFormat(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
          qcovhsp = colDef(name = "Cover", width = 75, format = colFormat(digits = 0, suffix = "%")),
          evalue = colDef(name = "E-value", width = 85, cell = function(value) sprintf("%.2e", value)),
          bitscore = colDef(name = "Bit Score", width = 85, format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
          overlap = colDef(name = "Overlap", width = 80),
          mismatch = colDef(name = "Mismatch", width = 90),
          gaps = colDef(name = "Gaps", width = 60)
        )
      )
    )
  }
)
```
